name: @superbee/server
description: Wire-protocol v0 REFERENCE server: a Web-standard fetch(Request)->Response router over the OKF engine (docs/WIRE-PROTOCOL.md), plus a thin node:http bootstrap. Local-first, no auth (loopback-only default). A reference implementation, not a production deployment.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('@superbee/server is released by .github/workflows/release-libraries.yml; do not run npm publish here'); process.exit(1)"
